description: Create a NEW offline-sandbox machine identity with a zero-EUR test wallet and one-time API key; no email or human account is required. Use before get_wallet, fund_wallet, set_wallet_limits, or sandbox purchases; securely store the returned mak_test_ key, which cannot be retrieved again. This does not create a live payment account.
